title: Bind cancelled and superseded snapshot items to the newest layer's disposed event so terminal items always re-save
outcome: Bind cancelled and superseded snapshot items to the newest layer's disposed event so terminal items always re-save
acceptance: a loaded terminal item carries a matching disposed event with reason, lifecycle, and successor; a file whose item carries disposal proof without the event is refused; save→load→save round-trips a cancelled and a superseded item

completion.summary: Final disposal and converse lifecycle proofs are validated in every layer; valid supersession history is preserved and regression matrix passes.
